questions.q: Why did the S&P 500 and Dow end lower following the employment report?
o: Stronger-than-expected labor data raised fears of higher interest rates, which pushed Treasury yields up and compressed stock values.
An unexpected drop in employment figures caused investors to panic about a severe economic recession.
